title: shooter game aimbot
features:
1. AI Autoplayer (Smart Bot)

    Target Selection: Automatically finds the closest enemy based on distance.

    Pathfinding & Safety: Detects "voids" (holes) in the map to prevent falling and jumps over walls/obstacles automatically.

    Dynamic Movement: Sprints with Shift to close gaps, retreats if enemies are too close, and uses Strafing (zig-zag movement) during combat to make you harder to hit.

    Auto-Equip: Automatically presses the "1" key to pull out your weapon if your hands are empty.

2. Visuals (Full ESP)

    Box & Name ESP: Draws a box around players and displays their names.

    Skeleton ESP: Shows the player's bone structure for better visibility through walls.

    Tracers: Draws lines from your position to the enemies.

    Team Check: Ensures that your teammates are not targeted or highlighted.

3. Combat & Aiming

    Manual Aimbot: Locks onto enemies when holding the Right Mouse Button.

    Smart Auto-Shoot: Only fires when the bot has a clear line of sight (no walls between you and the enemy).

    Heal Boost: A background loop that force-regenerates your health faster.

4. Customization

    Crosshair System: A dedicated tab to choose between 10 different styles (Dot, Sniper, Chevron, Arrow, etc.).

    Target Parts: Ability to choose where to aim (Head, Torso, or Knees).
